plans.estimate_assumption: STANDARD: 1 request/prompt/message = 1 agentic model call of 20,000 input tokens (18,000 cache-read + 2,000 uncached) + 1,500 output = 21,500 tokens. Window plans: 4 usable 5h windows/day x 30 days = 120 windows/month, then capped by weekly cap x 30/7 and by any monthly cap (whichever binds first). Dollar-pool plans: pool / blended reference rate for the same token mix at Claude Sonnet 5.5 list ($2 in / $0.20 cache-read / $10 out per Mtok) = $1.0512/Mtok. T3: 4 usable windows/day x $0.40 + $4 overage = $52 API value/month.
